module purpose: This block synchronizes the JTAG inputs into the clk_i domain, runs a TAP-style control state machine, shifts and captures instruction/data registers, and drives the selected scan bit on jtag_tdo_o. It also translates DMI register updates into internal DMI request fields and captures DMI response data and completion for later JTAG readback.

use-case flows.value: synchronized JTAG TCK/TMS/TDI samples advance the TAP state machine and shift or capture the instruction and data registers
a DR_UPDATE pulse commits the selected data register and can start a DMI read or write transaction
DTMCS bits 16 and 17 become the dmireset and dmihardreset control state
DMI response data and error status are captured and assembled for DMI readback
the selected instruction or data-register bit is driven on jtag_tdo_o on synchronized TCK falling edges
rstn_i clears the synchronizers, TAP/control registers, scan registers and DMI control state, and dmireset or dmihardreset clears err

conceptual assets.concept: TAP controller state that sequences instruction and data scan behavior
conceptual assets.reasoning: tap_ctrl_state is the stored sequencing state updated by the case tree at lines 123-139 when tap_sync.tck_rising='1' (line 121). The same state gates DR-update pulse generation (lines 151-156), instruction capture/shift (lines 178-181), data-register capture/shift (lines 185-197), and TDO source selection (lines 203-210), so integrity of this state is required for the operate, start and read-out flows; availability is the implemented ability to advance on qualified TCK edges.

conceptual assets.concept: DR_UPDATE event that authorizes data-register commit actions
conceptual assets.reasoning: dr_trigger.sreg is driven from tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE at lines 151-156, and dr_trigger.valid is asserted when dr_trigger.sreg = "01" at line 161. This computed event gates DTMCS control application (lines 247-249), overlap-error setting (lines 258-259), and DMI request acceptance (lines 265-270), so its integrity is required for the start and configure flows.

tap_reg.ireg is forced to addr_idcode_c in LOGIC_RESET or IR_CAPTURE (lines 178-179) and shifted from tap_sync.tdi in IR_SHIFT (lines 180-181). Its value selects which data register captures/shifts (lines 186-197), which source reaches jtag_tdo_o (lines 206-210), and whether the controller interprets a valid update as DTMCS or DMI (lines 247, 258 and 265); jtag_tdo_o also reports the instruction bit during IR_SHIFT (lines 203-204).

conceptual assets.concept: Identification word assembled from the IDCODE generics
conceptual assets.reasoning: When DR_CAPTURE occurs with addr_idcode_c selected, tap_reg.idcode loads IDCODE_VERSION & IDCODE_PARTID & IDCODE_MANID & '1' (lines 185-187), then shifts in DR_SHIFT (line 194) and is read out on jtag_tdo_o (lines 206-207). Integrity is established because the external reader should receive exactly that configured word; availability is conditional on IDCODE selection and read-out state.

conceptual assets.concept: DTMCS reset-control bits that command dmireset and dmihardreset
conceptual assets.reasoning: tap_reg.dtmcs holds the DTMCS scan word during DR capture/shift (lines 188 and 195). On a valid update with addr_dtmcs_c selected, dmi_ctrl.dmireset and dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset are loaded from tap_reg.dtmcs(16) and tap_reg.dtmcs(17) (lines 247-249), reflected back into tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt for readback (lines 220-221), clear dmi_ctrl.err when asserted (lines 256-257), and dmihardreset blocks new DMI requests (line 265).

conceptual assets.concept: Accepted DMI request command fields: address, write data and operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: When dmi_ctrl.busy='0', dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset='0', dr_trigger.valid='1' and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dmi_c, the controller copies tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34) to dmi_ctrl.addr and tap_reg.dmi(33 downto 02) to dmi_ctrl.wdata (lines 266-267), and for read/write op codes copies tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0) to dmi_ctrl.op and sets busy (lines 268-270). Integrity is established because the downstream consumer must receive exactly the decoded command; the dmi_req_o record port itself is omitted under the transport-port exclusion.

dmi_ctrl.busy is set only on an accepted read/write command (lines 268-270) and cleared only when dmi_rsp_i.ack='1' while busy (lines 274-276). This state gates self-clearing of reset controls (lines 250-252), acceptance of a new request (lines 264-270), response capture (line 274), and overlap-error generation (lines 258-259), so integrity of the in-progress decision is required; availability is ack-dependent as implemented.

conceptual assets.concept: DMI response data and error status returned through the DMI scan register
conceptual assets.reasoning: While busy, dmi_ctrl.rdata copies dmi_rsp_i.data (line 274). dmi_ctrl.err clears on dmireset or dmihardreset (lines 256-257) and sets when a new DMI update arrives while busy (lines 258-259); tap_reg.dmi_nxt packs the reported word (line 229), tap_reg.dmi captures it on DR_CAPTURE when addr_dmi_c is selected (lines 185 and 189), and jtag_tdo_o shifts it out when DMI is selected (lines 206 and 209). Integrity is established because the JTAG reader should receive exactly the returned data/error state; the dmi_rsp_i record port is omitted under the transport-port exclusion.
